source: Measured by the author, 2026-10-31. Only distance, reading and scale: no personal data.

sets.label: doubtful
sets.note: The step from 40 m to 50 m is smaller (0.7) than the one before (0.8). The author doubts the 40 m mark. Its deviation from the trend of the other four is only about 1.2 mm, the same size as the 1.05 mm of the 50 m mark of the good set, so by the numbers alone it cannot be told apart from normal measuring noise.
